description: Source code for a Git credential helper that interacts with macOS Keychain to store, retrieve, and delete credentials using Security framework APIs.

methods.name: clear_credential
methods.description: Releases and clears stored credential references.

methods.name: create_dictionary
methods.description: Creates a mutable CFDictionary with variable arguments.

methods.name: write_item
methods.description: Outputs a credential item to stdout.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf
methods.description: Appends credential item to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf_cfstring
methods.description: Appends CFStringRef credential item to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf_cfnumber
methods.description: Appends CFNumberRef credential item to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf_cfdata
methods.description: Appends CFDataRef credential item to a strbuf.

methods.name: encode_state_seen
methods.description: Encodes credential state into a strbuf.

methods.name: find_username_in_item
methods.description: Extracts username from a Keychain item dictionary.

methods.name: find_internet_password
methods.description: Retrieves password and associated info from Keychain.

methods.name: delete_internet_password
methods.description: Deletes internet password entries from Keychain.

methods.name: add_internet_password
methods.description: Stores a new internet password in Keychain.

methods.name: read_credential
methods.description: Reads credential data from stdin and parses it.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the credential helper, handling get/store/erase commands.
